chapters.title: Prologue
chapters.summary: A voice in the Void, and a ruined palace at the end of it.

chapters.title: The Long Road
chapters.summary: Three lessons on the road away from the palace.

chapters.title: Chapter I
chapters.summary: A wall that outlived the war it was built for.

chapters.title: The Smith's Errand
chapters.summary: A finished sword, and a delivery nobody has been able to make.

chapters.title: Names on the Wall
chapters.summary: A mason still carving names, and a watch that was never relieved.

chapters.title: Chapter II
chapters.summary: Two roads leave the General's line.

chapters.title: Bell Tower
chapters.summary: The tower keeps the last day of the war. Every bell raises the dead.

chapters.title: Courtyard
chapters.summary: Three answers the King once asked for, and none of them helped.

chapters.title: Chapter III
chapters.summary: Beyond the bell and the court, two ways further down.

chapters.title: Dragon Tomb
chapters.summary: A machine that predicted the end of the war and was buried for it.

chapters.title: Blank Archive
chapters.summary: Every number in the histories has been quietly rewritten.

chapters.title: Finale
chapters.summary: The last duel, and the water beyond it.
